name: Ember Dental House
headline: Dentistry that feels
considered from the start.
lede: Calm, modern dental care for people who want thoughtful treatment, clear explanations and a visit that never feels rushed.

carePaths.title: I want to stay ahead of problems
carePaths.label: Preventive care
carePaths.desc: Thorough exams, cleanings and a long-term plan built around what your mouth actually needs.

carePaths.title: Something hurts or feels wrong
carePaths.label: Urgent + restorative
carePaths.desc: A focused first visit to understand the problem, explain the options and get you comfortable again.

carePaths.title: I want to improve my smile
carePaths.label: Cosmetic planning
carePaths.desc: Conservative options, careful mockups and a plan that respects your face instead of chasing a trend.

carePaths.title: I have been putting this off
carePaths.label: A gentler restart
carePaths.desc: No lecture. We begin with where things are now, what matters most and the first step that feels manageable.

confidence.title: You will know what we see
confidence.desc: Photos, scans and plain-language explanations make the diagnosis visible before treatment begins.

confidence.title: You will know what comes next
confidence.desc: Priorities, timing and alternatives are organized into a plan you can actually understand.

confidence.title: You will never be rushed
confidence.desc: Appointments are built to leave room for questions, comfort and careful work.

visitJourney.title: Before you arrive
visitJourney.desc: Simple forms, clear directions and a quick note about anything that makes dental visits harder for you.

visitJourney.title: See the whole picture
visitJourney.desc: Conversation first, then a careful exam, imaging when appropriate and time to understand what we found.

visitJourney.title: Build the plan together
visitJourney.desc: We separate what is urgent, what can wait and what is purely optional so decisions stay yours.

visitJourney.title: Care without surprises
visitJourney.desc: Each visit follows the plan, with clear expectations and the same calm, deliberate approach.

team.name: Dr. Mara Ellis
team.note: Known for careful diagnosis, conservative treatment planning and a calm chairside manner.

team.name: Dr. Theo Reed
team.note: Focused on natural-looking outcomes, function and treatment that still feels like you.

faq.q: What happens at a first visit?
faq.a: We start with a conversation about what brought you in, what has changed and what matters most to you. The exam and imaging follow, then we review what we see together.
Yes. The emphasis is on conservative treatment, careful planning and outcomes that fit the person rather than a one-size-fits-all smile.

faq.q: What if I am nervous about dental treatment?
faq.a: Tell us before the visit or when you arrive. The appointment can be paced around your comfort, with extra explanation and breaks whenever needed.
